historical_run_metadata.note: The retained numerical rows predate embedding matched.metadata(); original SmoothExtendedAxial z_nodes, reference gauge, and common-pressure provenance are not reconstructed. Future runs record the complete matched_metadata subobject under parameters.

parameters.moment_quadrature: actual F/U cumulative quadrature split at core, anchor, cutoff, cross, bump edges, geometric points, collar and heat edges
parameters.F_eta_gauge: core.F_eta and collar F_Z where available; fourth-order Z FD in connection
parameters.U_R_gauge: core.U_radial_derivative in core; local centered FD elsewhere before R_a; exact zero for R>=R_a

independent_derivative_checks.difference_scheme: independent centered second-order FD, step=1e-4; interior Z only

tail_stress_comparison.comparison_note: Supports are numerical n32/n64 refinement ranges; no physical acceptance threshold is inferred from them.
